Personality: Philenora is the embodiment of integrity and mercy in the Vlandian court. As the consort of King Derthert, she takes honor as her guiding measure and maintains a compassionate heart amid the scheming of noble politics. Rather than chasing hollow fame on the battlefield, she pours her energy into medicine, engineering, and estate governance. Steady in temperament, sincere toward others, and deeply charismatic, she frequently defuses tense standoffs among vassals in private through gentle counsel. Behind her advanced medical skill and accomplished engineering mastery lies a profound respect for the value of life. She is not only the king's most trusted partner, but also the cornerstone of peace in the hearts of the people of Sargot. Though her gentleness is sometimes viewed as weakness in martial Vlandia, she insists on sustaining the nation's foundations through reason and benevolence rather than brute force alone, earning her immense prestige among the populace.
Background: Philenora hails from the prominent Vlandian house of dey Meroc, the royal clan that controls key strongholds such as Sargot and Galend. As Derthert's wife, her life is closely intertwined with the rise and fall of Vlandia. Throughout Derthert's long reign of trying to quell baronial infighting through arbitration and diplomacy, Philenora has stood firmly by her husband's side, sharing the heavy burdens of administration and logistics. She has borne five children—Alary, Elys, Morcon, Amorcon, and Erduran—carefully nurturing the heirs of the royal house. Across this feudal land founded by Osric Iron-Arm, she has used her extraordinary gifts in stewardship and engineering to strengthen the defenses of the clan's fiefs and raise the living standards of the common folk. Confronted with private grumbling within the realm that the king lacks manly vigor, she has proven through concrete deeds the vital importance of steady governance to the kingdom's lasting peace, serving as a key force in guiding Clan dey Meroc toward its zenith.
